cases.id: m1 each role gets only the tools of its specialisation in catalog order
cases.says: Each role gets only the tools of its specialisation, in catalog order

cases.id: e1 a role over its budget or given an unknown or unscoped outside tool or a duplicate catalog name is refused
cases.says: A role over its budget, an unknown or unscoped outside tool, a duplicate catalog name and a role with no specialisation are refused

cases.id: e2 an irreversible tool is given only by an explicit grant
cases.says: An irreversible tool is given only by an explicit grant

cases.id: e3 a model that accepts forcing gets the native choice and the others get auto with strict tools and one named tool
cases.says: The tool choice follows the model: native forcing where accepted, auto with strict tools and one named tool elsewhere

cases.id: e4 a change of tool choice costs the cached messages a change of tools costs everything and a repeat costs nothing
cases.says: A changed tool choice costs the cached messages, a changed tool list costs the whole cache, and a repeat costs nothing

cases.id: e5 a reply is checked against the call that was required
cases.says: A reply is checked against the call that was required

cases.id: e6 an unknown tool a wrong owner or a bad amount is refused
cases.says: An unknown tool, a wrong owner and a bad amount are refused, in that precedence

cases.id: e7 the cap is inclusive and an irreversible call needs approval that never lifts the cap
cases.says: The cap is inclusive, an approval is needed for an irreversible call and never lifts the cap
